description: Cross-language parity probes. All four implementations must reproduce every field exactly (integers) or to 1e-12 (floats), using the shared RNG spec in docs/RNG.md.

probes.call: Percolation(build_lattice('square',32), 'bond'); 500 samples at p=0.5 with Rng(1234); count crosses_lr()
Percolation(build_lattice('triangular',16), 'site'); 300 samples at p=0.5 with Rng(777); count crosses_lr()
newman_ziff(build_lattice('square',16), Rng(5), checkpoints=64); smax at indices len//4, len//2, len-1
directed_crossing(build_lattice('square',32), p=0.65, Rng(4242), mode='bond'); 500 samples; count cross
directed_crossing(build_lattice('square',32), p=0.70, Rng(4242), mode='site'); 500 samples; count cross
